start.title: [TODO:de] The Plain of Shinar
start.text:
[TODO:de] A wide green plain stretches ahead.
All mankind has gathered here — one people, one tongue.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: [TODO:de] One Tongue
unity.text:
[TODO:de] Voices blend. Laughter rises.
There is no word you cannot understand.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: [TODO:de] The Great Idea
proposal.text:
[TODO:de] An elder rises. "Let us build a tower — its top in the heavens."
"Let us make a name for ourselves."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: [TODO:de] Bricks and Tar
bricks.text:
[TODO:de] You mold wet clay into bricks.
They are stronger than stone. They will reach the sky.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: [TODO:de] The First Floors
construction.text:
[TODO:de] Walls rise. The tower casts a long shadow.
Men sing as they lift each beam.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: [TODO:de] Higher
rising.text:
[TODO:de] Year after year. Stone upon stone.
The tower pierces the clouds.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: [TODO:de] Touching the Sky
summit.text:
[TODO:de] You stand at the top. The earth is small below.
The heavens feel close — almost within reach.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: [TODO:de] He Comes Down
gods_gaze.text:
[TODO:de] A voice fills the air, calm as thunder.
"They are one people. Nothing will be impossible for them."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: [TODO:de] Strange Words
confusion.text:
[TODO:de] You shout to your friend. He stares.
His mouth opens — but the sounds make no sense.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: [TODO:de] Going Out
scattering.text:
[TODO:de] Families gather what they can.
Each group walks toward a different horizon.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: [TODO:de] A New Land
reflection.text:
[TODO:de] You stop on a quiet ridge.
The tower is far behind — a memory of pride.
